purpose: Lorebook management hub whose guarded apply path writes reviewed agent proposals into real lorebooks with backups and staleness checks.
probe: async () => { const el = window.EL; return !!el && typeof el.applyProposal === 'function' && !!el.ready && typeof el.ready.then === 'function' && !!(await el.ready); }
absentNotice: ST-EnhancedLorebook is not available; lorebook access is disabled.

methods.name: applyProposal
methods.inputs: proposal: { id, action: 'create'|'edit'|'delete', lorebookName, status, uid, entryData, changes, _baseFingerprint }; opts: { st?, agentName? }
methods.outputs: true after a verified write; proposal removed from feed, badge refreshed, el:proposals-changed emitted

methods.name: buildLineDiffHtml
methods.outputs: line-diff HTML, or '' when the shared apply core is not loaded

methods.name: guardSave
methods.inputs: lorebook name, full lorebook data and guard options
methods.outputs: true when the verified save landed, false when blocked/skipped

methods.name: registerLorebookPlugin
methods.signature: await window.EL.plugins.register({ id, name, title?, icon?, run }) => string
methods.inputs: descriptor: unique id, display name/title, optional icon; run(ctx) is async and returns { items: [{ comment, key, content, order }] }
methods.outputs: the registered id; plugin appears in the expandable Plugins section at the bottom of the entry editor panel

methods.name: listLorebookPlugins
methods.outputs: metadata for locally and remotely registered plugins (functions are never returned)

events.name: el:proposals-changed
events.payload: { chatId, count, reason } where reason is 'created' | 'accepted' | 'denied' | 'deleted' | 'loaded'

example: await window.EL.plugins.register({ id: 'myext.stats', name: 'Stats', run: () => ({ items: [] }) });
